MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 3
   C. 40
   D. 41

2. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 13
   C. 1
   D. 7

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 42

4. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 10
   C. 24
   D. 25

5. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

6. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 11
   C. 121
   D. 122

7. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 1
   C. 56
   D. 57

8. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

9. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 144

10. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 7
   D. 49

11. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 31
   C. 27
   D. 25

12. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 36

13. Solve for x: x + 6 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 10
   C. 6
   D. 4

14. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 5
   C. 10
   D. 25

15. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 13

16. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 82
   C. 81
   D. 9

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

18. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
